# solidping Provider

Manage [SolidPing](https://www.solidping.io) monitoring as code: checks, notification channels, status pages and maintenance windows.

The provider talks to one organization of one SolidPing server, with an organization-scoped personal access token (dashboard: **Account → Tokens**, or `POST /api/v1/orgs/{org}/tokens`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    solidping = {
      source = "fclairamb/solidping"
    }
  }
}

# The three settings can also come from the environment:
# SOLIDPING_ENDPOINT, SOLIDPING_ORG and SOLIDPING_TOKEN.
provider "solidping" {
  endpoint = "https://solidping.acme.com"
  org      = "acme"
  token    = var.solidping_token
}

variable "solidping_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the SolidPing server, e.g. `https://solidping.acme.com`. Falls back to the `SOLIDPING_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `org` (String) Slug of the organization to manage. Falls back to the `SOLIDPING_ORG` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Organization-scoped personal access token. Falls back to the `SOLIDPING_TOKEN` environment variable.
